newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Israel criticizes Brazil over Palestinian meetings.
newsitem.headline: Israel criticizes Brazil over Palestinian meetings.

text.p: Israel on Thursday protested a series of meetings between a freed Palestinian guerrilla and officials in Brazil and said the special treatment awarded her was "incomprehensible."

"It had been hoped that the supporters of peace, among them the official representatives of a peaceful country like Brazil, would avoid meeting people who symbolise terrorism and violence," the Israeli Embassy in Brasilia said in a statement.

Lamia Maarouf, a Brazilian-born member of the Palestinian liberation movement Al Fatah, served 11 years of a life sentence in Israel for her role in the murder of an Israeli army sergeant. She was freed in February.
Since returning to Brazil, she has met with several Brazilian officials, including this week the presidents of the two houses of Congress and a Foreign Ministry official.
